alternatives.description: Keep the older manually maintained Git operating context and omit the reviewed v2 source/recovery/secret-scan hardening.
alternatives.projected_effect: Known Git-process drift and recovery ambiguity remain.
alternatives.risk: Repeated stale-context, unsafe cleanup, and recovery-process defects remain more likely.

alternatives.description: Admit one structured Git-process source with generated views, typed recovery, preflight and central secret-scan enforcement.
alternatives.projected_effect: Repository mutation mechanics become source-bound, reproducible and safer without altering Garden canon.
alternatives.risk: Operational process coupling increases and protected workflow changes still require normal trusted-base admission.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING lacks one authoritative structured source, generated-view verification, typed bad-merge recovery and central secret scanning.
Process v2 adds maintained source/generation and CI obligations absent from the older looser process.

assumptions: Garden v15.5 canonical source remains unchanged.
Live GitHub rules remain authoritative over stale snapshots.
Operational Git receipts cannot mint Garden authority.
reason.uncertainty: Live GitHub rules and concurrent work can change after this receipt; exact-head verification remains required immediately before merge.
counterexamples: A generated view drifting from the source invalidates the single-source claim.
A force-push rollback would violate the recovery policy.
Deleting garden-review-state as an ordinary stale branch would violate the branch-cleanup boundary.
A secret-scan allowlist that permits real credentials would invalidate the protection.
reason.conclusion: Admit the bounded noncanonical Git-process-v2 implementation only through ordinary exact-head checks and trusted-base admission; preserve canonical Garden v15.5 unchanged.

obligations.statement: Generated human and machine views exactly derive from one structured source.
Bad-merge recovery forbids history rewrite and uses governed revert/forward-fix PRs.
Branch cleanup preserves persistent review state and requires explicit eligibility evidence.

items.claim_scope: Instruction to finish the Garden merge/cleanup process; not blanket protected-change approval.
HUMAN-admitted GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess@1.4 remains the governing process.
